notes: Bannerlator 3.2.2: faster upscalers (NIS -80 %), frame-gen engine switch in-game and per-game frame-gen settings, Wine / Proton list with family updates, Sync CPU topology and named core pickers, idle-thread throttle switches, Wayland desktop cursors, community control profiles, Xbox Cloud Gaming audio over HDMI/USB/Bluetooth, store fixes.

highlights.title: Faster upscalers
highlights.text: FSR, CAS and SGSR HQ + CAS about a third cheaper; NIS 80 % cheaper with the same picture.

highlights.title: Frame gen in-game
highlights.text: Switch between Off, LSFG Native, Win-FG Native and WFG while the game runs; changes stay with that game.

highlights.title: Wine / Proton list
highlights.text: Proton and Wine tabs, family groups, one row per layer, and updates inside each Proton family.

highlights.title: Cores
highlights.text: Sync CPU topology, and core pickers, HUD and Task Manager that name each core.

highlights.title: Community profiles
highlights.text: Winlator's original layouts and the layouts shared in our Discord.
